passages.title: 冒黑煙的鬆餅
passages.text: On Sunday morning, I wanted to surprise my parents with pancakes. I had never made them before, but how hard could it be? I put the pan on the stove and went to my room to get my phone. Five minutes later, I {1} something strange. Black {2} was coming out of the kitchen! I ran back and turned off the fire. The pancake in the {3} of the pan was as black as coal. Mom and Dad came running. "What happened?" Dad asked. I explained the {4}: I left the kitchen while I was cooking. Mom opened the windows. "You will {5} be a good cook one day," she laughed, "but never leave the stove again." Then she taught me how to make pancakes the right way. Our second try was perfect.

blanks.why: smelled something strange「聞到奇怪的味道」，接著就看到黑煙。seemed、appeared 後面不能直接接受詞 something；cheered（歡呼）也說不通。
black smoke「黑煙」從廚房冒出來。joy（喜悅）、topic（主題）、grade（年級、成績）都不會從廚房冒出來。
in the middle of the pan「在鍋子中間」。topic、reason、joy 都不能接 of the pan 表示位置。
explained the reason「解釋原因」，冒號後面就是原因：煮東西時離開廚房。smoke、plant、grade 都不是能「解釋」的內容。
will probably be「大概會成為」，probably 放在 will 和動詞中間。ago 要放在時間後面；abroad（在國外）、ahead（在前面）放在這裡都不通。

passages.zh: 星期天早上，我想做鬆餅給爸媽一個驚喜。我以前從沒做過，但能有多難呢？我把鍋子放在爐子上，然後回房間拿手機。五分鐘後，我聞到一股奇怪的味道——黑煙從廚房冒出來了！我跑回去把火關掉，鍋子中間的那片鬆餅黑得像煤炭一樣。爸媽跑了過來。「發生什麼事了？」爸爸問。我解釋了原因：我煮東西的時候離開了廚房。媽媽打開窗戶，笑著說：「你以後大概會是個好廚師，但絕對不要再離開爐子了。」接著她教我用正確的方法做鬆餅。我們第二次做得非常完美。

passages.title: 九年級的英文演講
passages.text: This year, I am in the ninth {1}. Our English teacher asked everyone to give a two-minute speech. I was very nervous. The {2} was "My Hero." I decided to talk about my grandma. She raised me after my parents moved {3} for work. The {4} idea of my speech was simple: heroes don't need superpowers. They just need a big heart. When I finished, the classroom was quiet. Then everyone clapped. My teacher said, "That was a speech full of love." When I told Grandma about it that night, her face was full of {5}.

blanks.why: in the ninth grade「九年級」。topic（主題）、reason（原因）、joy（喜悅）都不能表示年級。
The topic was "My Hero."「題目是《我的英雄》」。smoke（煙）、plant（植物）、middle（中間）都不能當演講的題目。
moved abroad「搬到國外」，爸媽出國工作。ago 要放在時間後面；quite（相當）要修飾形容詞或副詞；ever 不能放在 moved 後面。
the main idea「主旨、主要的想法」。hungry（餓的）、wet（濕的）不能形容想法；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
full of joy「充滿喜悅」，阿嬤聽到後很開心。smoke、topic、grade 都不能形容臉上的表情。

passages.zh: 今年我九年級了。我們的英文老師要每個人上台做兩分鐘的演講，我非常緊張。題目是「我的英雄」，我決定講我的阿嬤。我爸媽到國外工作之後，就是她把我養大的。我演講的主旨很簡單：英雄不需要超能力，只需要一顆很大的心。我講完時，教室裡一片安靜，接著大家都鼓掌了。老師說：「這是一篇充滿愛的演講。」那天晚上我告訴阿嬤這件事，她的臉上滿是喜悅。

passages.title: 植樹節的小樹苗
passages.text: March 12 is Arbor Day in Taiwan. This year, our class went to a park to {1} trees. Each group got a small tree, a shovel, and a bucket of water. My group dug a hole in the {2} of the field. It was {3} hard work because the ground was dry. After we put the tree in, we gave it water. "This tree will {4} grow taller than this building in twenty years," our teacher said. We all wrote our names on a small card and tied it to the tree. When we left, I looked back. The tree was very small, but it gave me a feeling of {5}. I will come back to see it every year.

blanks.why: plant trees「種樹」，植樹節要做的事。smoke（抽菸）、lend（借出）、cheer（歡呼）接 trees 都不通。
in the middle of the field「在草地中間」。topic、reason、joy 都不能接 of the field 表示位置。
quite hard work「相當辛苦的工作」，quite 修飾 hard。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能修飾形容詞。
will probably grow「大概會長得…」，probably 放在 will 和動詞中間。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這個位置。
a feeling of joy「一種喜悅的感覺」。smoke（煙）、grade（成績）、topic（主題）都不是感覺。

passages.zh: 三月十二日是台灣的植樹節。今年，我們班到一座公園去種樹。每組拿到一棵小樹、一把鏟子和一桶水。我們這組在草地中間挖了一個洞，因為地面很乾，挖起來相當辛苦。把樹放進去之後，我們幫它澆水。「二十年後，這棵樹大概會長得比這棟大樓還高。」老師說。我們都把名字寫在一張小卡片上，綁在樹上。離開時，我回頭看，那棵樹雖然很小，卻讓我感到一種喜悅。我每年都會回來看它。

passages.title: 外婆的視訊晚餐
passages.text: Since Grandpa died last year, Grandma has lived alone in Tainan. She said she was fine, but on the phone, her voice {1} sad. Mom said, "She {2} feels {3}. She eats dinner by herself every night." So we came up with an idea. Every Sunday night, we have a video call with Grandma during dinner. We put the phone in the {4} of the table, and she eats with us. She tells us about her garden, and we tell her about school. Last week, she said, "Sunday is now my favorite day. You are the {5} I smile."

blanks.why: seemed sad「聽起來很難過」，seem + 形容詞。lent、borrowed、cheered 都不能直接接形容詞。
probably feels「大概覺得」，probably 放在一般動詞前面。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這個位置。
feels lonely「覺得孤單」，因為每天一個人吃晚餐。modern（現代的）、national（國家的）、expensive（昂貴的）都不能形容人的心情。
in the middle of the table「在餐桌中間」，讓阿嬤像跟大家一起吃飯。topic、reason、grade 都不能表示位置。
You are the reason I smile.「你們是我微笑的原因」。smoke、plant、topic 都說不通。

passages.zh: 自從外公去年過世後，外婆就一個人住在台南。她說她很好，但在電話裡，她的聲音聽起來很難過。媽媽說：「她大概覺得很孤單，每天晚上都一個人吃飯。」所以我們想到了一個辦法：每個星期天晚上吃飯時，我們都跟外婆視訊。我們把手機放在餐桌中間，讓她跟我們一起吃。她跟我們說她菜園的事，我們跟她說學校的事。上星期，她說：「星期天現在是我最喜歡的日子。你們是我微笑的原因。」

passages.title: 爸爸戒菸記
passages.text: My dad started to {1} when he was in college. For twenty years, he smoked a pack a day. We asked him to stop many times, but he always said, "Next year." Then last month, my little sister came home from school with a poster. She drew a pair of black lungs in the {2} of the paper. "Daddy, this is your body," she said. "My teacher said people who smoke will {3} get sick." Dad looked at the picture for a long time. That night, he threw away all his cigarettes. "You are my {4} to quit," he told her. The first two weeks were hard. He was often angry and couldn't sleep well. But he didn't give up. Now he goes jogging every morning. "I can taste food again!" he said with {5}.

blanks.why: started to smoke「開始抽菸」，後面說他每天抽一包。lend、borrow 後面要接借的東西；seem 後面要接形容詞或 to＋動詞。
in the middle of the paper「在紙的中間」。topic、reason、joy 都不能表示位置。
will probably get sick「大概會生病」，probably 放在 will 和動詞中間。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。
my reason to quit「我戒菸的理由」。smoke、plant、grade 都不能接 to quit 表示理由。
said with joy「開心地說」，能再嚐出食物的味道。smoke、topic、grade 都不能和 said with 搭配表示心情。

passages.zh: 我爸爸讀大學的時候開始抽菸，二十年來每天抽一包。我們要他戒菸很多次，他總是說：「明年再說。」上個月，我妹妹從學校帶了一張海報回家。她在紙的中間畫了一對黑色的肺。「爸爸，這是你的身體，」她說，「老師說抽菸的人大概會生病。」爸爸看著那張畫看了很久。那天晚上，他把所有的菸都丟了。「你就是我戒菸的理由。」他對妹妹說。頭兩個星期很難熬，他常常發脾氣，也睡不好，但他沒有放棄。現在他每天早上去慢跑。「我又嚐得出食物的味道了！」他開心地說。

passages.title: 瓦力的小綠芽
passages.text: In the movie WALL-E, Earth is covered with garbage, and people have left. WALL-E is a small robot. Every day, he cleans up garbage alone. He is very {1}. His only friend is a cockroach. One day, he finds something special: a small green {2} growing in an old boot. Then a robot named EVE comes to Earth. Her {3} job is to find plants. WALL-E falls in love with her. He gives her the plant, and she takes it back to a spaceship. The plant is the {4} people can return to Earth: it shows that Earth can grow things again. In the end, people come home and start planting. WALL-E is {5} the cutest robot in movie history.

blanks.why: very lonely「非常孤單」，他每天獨自工作，唯一的朋友是蟑螂。modern、national、expensive 都不能形容他的心情。
a small green plant「一株綠色小植物」，長在舊靴子裡。topic、grade、reason 都不能「長」出來。
her main job「她主要的任務」。hungry（餓的）、wet（濕的）不能形容工作；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
the reason people can return「人們能回到地球的原因」。smoke、joy、middle 都說不通。
is probably the cutest「大概是最可愛的」，probably 放在 be 動詞後面。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。

gloss: 瓦力（皮克斯動畫電影的機器人）
passages.zh: 在電影《瓦力》裡，地球被垃圾蓋滿，人類都離開了。瓦力是一個小機器人，每天獨自清理垃圾。他非常孤單，唯一的朋友是一隻蟑螂。有一天，他發現了一個特別的東西：一株長在舊靴子裡的綠色小植物。後來，一個叫伊芙的機器人來到地球，她主要的任務就是尋找植物。瓦力愛上了她。他把植物送給她，她把它帶回太空船。這株植物就是人類能回到地球的原因：它代表地球又能種出東西了。最後，人們回到家園，開始種植物。瓦力大概是電影史上最可愛的機器人了。

passages.title: 選不出來的報告主題
passages.text: Our social studies teacher asked us to do a group report. We could choose any {1} about Taiwan. My group talked for an hour, but we couldn't agree. The {2} was simple: everyone loved a different idea. Amy wanted to talk about night markets. Ken wanted to talk about baseball. I wanted to talk about temples. Finally, our teacher came over. "What is the {3} problem here?" she asked. We told her. She smiled. "Why not put them together? Many night markets are next to temples, and people watch baseball games in night markets." That was a great idea! Our report was called "A Night in Taiwan." We worked hard and got the best {4} in the class. We were {5} the happiest group in school that day.

blanks.why: any topic about Taiwan「任何和台灣有關的主題」。smoke（煙）、joy（喜悅）、middle（中間）都不能當報告主題。
The reason was simple「原因很簡單」，冒號後面說明原因。smoke、plant、grade 都不能接冒號來說明為什麼吵不出結果。
the main problem「主要的問題」。hungry、wet 不能形容問題；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
got the best grade「得到最好的成績」。smoke（煙）、plant（植物）、joy（喜悅）都不能用 got the best … in the class 表示成績。
were probably the happiest「大概是最開心的」，probably 放在 be 動詞後面。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。

passages.zh: 社會老師要我們做一份小組報告，可以選任何和台灣有關的主題。我們這組討論了一個小時，還是無法決定。原因很簡單：每個人喜歡的點子都不一樣。Amy 想講夜市，Ken 想講棒球，我想講廟宇。最後，老師走過來問：「這裡主要的問題是什麼？」我們告訴她。她笑著說：「為什麼不把它們放在一起呢？很多夜市就在廟旁邊，而且大家也會在夜市看棒球比賽。」真是好主意！我們的報告叫做「台灣的一個夜晚」。我們很努力，拿到了全班最好的成績。那天，我們大概是全校最開心的一組。

passages.title: 飛機上中間的位子
passages.text: Last summer, I flew to Japan with my parents. When we got on the plane, I found my seat. It was in the {1} of a row, between two strangers. On my left was a big man who was sleeping. On my right was an old lady. I felt a little {2} because my parents were sitting far away. Then the old lady smiled at me. "Is this your first trip to Japan?" she asked in English. She was from Osaka. For three hours, she told me about Japanese food and taught me some Japanese words. I learned {3} a lot. When the plane landed, she gave me a paper crane. "This is for good luck," she said. That is {4} the {5} reason I now love the middle seat.

blanks.why: in the middle of a row「在一排的中間」，夾在兩個陌生人之間。topic、reason、joy 都不能表示座位的位置。
felt a little lonely「覺得有點孤單」，因為爸媽坐得很遠。modern、national、expensive 都不能形容心情。
learned quite a lot「學到相當多」，quite 可以修飾 a lot。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在 a lot 前面。
is probably…「大概是…」，probably 放在 be 動詞後面。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。
the main reason「主要的原因」。hungry、wet 不能形容原因；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我和爸媽搭飛機去日本。上飛機後，我找到自己的位子：在一排的中間，夾在兩個陌生人之間。我左邊是一個正在睡覺的高大男人，右邊是一位老太太。因為爸媽坐得很遠，我覺得有點孤單。這時，老太太對我笑了笑，用英文問：「這是你第一次去日本嗎？」她來自大阪。三個小時裡，她跟我介紹日本的食物，還教我一些日文。我學到了相當多。飛機降落時，她送我一隻紙鶴：「這是給你帶來好運的。」這大概就是我現在喜歡坐中間位子的主要原因。

passages.title: 數學成績進步了
passages.text: Last semester, my math {1} was only 52. I felt {2} terrible. My teacher said, "The {3} is not that you aren't smart. You just need more practice." So I made a plan. Every day, I did ten math questions after dinner. When I didn't understand something, I asked my classmates. This semester, I got 81 on the midterm! When the teacher gave back the tests, she said, "Someone made big progress." Then she called my name. I jumped up with {4}. My classmates laughed and clapped. At home, Mom put my test on the refrigerator. "You'll {5} get 90 next time," she said. I'm not sure about that, but I know I will try my best.

blanks.why: my math grade「我的數學成績」，只有 52 分。smoke、plant、joy 都不能表示分數。
felt quite terrible「覺得相當糟」，quite 修飾形容詞。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能修飾 terrible。
The reason is not that…「原因不是…」。smoke（煙）、plant（植物）、joy（喜悅）都不能接 that 子句說明原因。
jumped up with joy「高興得跳起來」。smoke、plant、topic 都不能和 with 搭配表示心情。
You'll probably get…「你大概會考…」，probably 放在 will 和動詞中間。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。

passages.zh: 上學期，我的數學成績只有 52 分，我覺得相當糟。老師說：「原因不是你不聰明，你只是需要多練習。」所以我訂了一個計畫：每天晚飯後做十題數學，不懂的地方就問同學。這學期的期中考，我考了 81 分！老師發考卷時說：「有人進步很多喔。」接著她叫了我的名字，我高興得跳了起來，同學們都笑著鼓掌。回到家，媽媽把我的考卷貼在冰箱上。「你下次大概會考 90 分。」她說。我不確定能不能做到，但我知道我會盡全力。

passages.title: 陽台上的小番茄
passages.text: In the spring, my mom and I decided to {1} tomatoes on our balcony. We bought some seeds and three big pots. "The {2} thing tomatoes need is sunshine," Mom said. Every morning before school, I gave them water. After two weeks, small green leaves came out. I was so happy that I took photos every day. But in the {3} of summer, a typhoon came. The strong wind knocked over one of the pots. I was very sad. "Don't worry," Mom said. "The other two will {4} be fine." She was right. In August, the plants were full of little red tomatoes. We picked them and made a salad. They were sweet and juicy. Eating something you grew yourself is a special kind of {5}.

blanks.why: plant tomatoes「種番茄」。smoke（抽菸）、lend（借出）、seem（似乎）接 tomatoes 都不通。
the main thing「最主要的東西」：番茄最需要陽光。hungry、wet 放在這裡都不通；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
in the middle of summer「在仲夏、夏天正中間」。topic、reason、grade 都不能接 of summer 表示時間。
will probably be fine「大概沒問題」，probably 放在 will 和動詞中間。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。
a special kind of joy「一種特別的快樂」。smoke、topic、grade 都不是吃自己種的東西時的感受。

passages.zh: 春天時，我和媽媽決定在陽台種番茄。我們買了一些種子和三個大花盆。「番茄最需要的就是陽光。」媽媽說。每天上學前，我都幫它們澆水。兩個星期後，小小的綠葉長出來了，我開心得每天都拍照。可是到了盛夏，颱風來了，強風把其中一個花盆打翻了，我非常難過。「別擔心，」媽媽說，「另外兩盆大概沒問題。」她說對了。到了八月，番茄長滿了紅紅的小果實。我們把它們摘下來做成沙拉，又甜又多汁。吃自己種的東西，是一種特別的快樂。

passages.title: 會尖叫的曼德拉草
passages.text: In the second Harry Potter book, Harry and his friends have a Herbology class. In this class, they learn about magic {1}. One day, Professor Sprout shows them Mandrakes. A Mandrake looks like an ugly little baby, and its cry is very {2}. If you hear it, you will faint. So the students have to wear earmuffs. Their {3} job that day is to move the young Mandrakes into bigger pots. It sounds easy, but the Mandrakes fight and kick. The {4} the school grows them is important: Mandrakes can help people who were turned to stone. Harry thinks this class is {5} the strangest one at Hogwarts.

blanks.why: magic plants「有魔法的植物」，藥草學就是學植物。topics（主題）、grades（成績）、reasons（原因）都不是課堂上照顧的東西。
very dangerous「非常危險」，聽到它的哭聲會昏倒。honest、national、hungry 都不能形容哭聲。
their main job「他們主要的工作」。hungry、wet 不能形容工作；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
The reason the school grows them…「學校種它們的原因」。smoke、joy、topic 都說不通。
is probably the strangest「大概是最奇怪的」，probably 放在 be 動詞後面。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。

passages.zh: 在《哈利波特》第二集裡，哈利和朋友們要上藥草學。這堂課要學各種有魔法的植物。有一天，芽菜教授給他們看曼德拉草。曼德拉草長得像一個醜醜的小嬰兒，它的哭聲非常危險，聽到就會昏倒，所以學生們都得戴上耳罩。他們那天主要的工作，是把小曼德拉草移到比較大的花盆裡。聽起來很簡單，但曼德拉草會又打又踢。學校種它們的原因很重要：曼德拉草可以救被石化的人。哈利覺得這堂課大概是霍格華茲最奇怪的一堂課了。

passages.title: 最孤單的鯨魚
passages.text: Since 1989, scientists have heard a strange whale song in the Pacific Ocean. Most whales sing at about 15 to 25 hertz, but this whale sings at 52 hertz. No other whale sings like it. Some people think it must feel very {1}. The {2} is simple: other whales {3} cannot understand its song. No one has ever seen this whale. Still, it became a popular {4} on the Internet. Many people wrote songs and drew pictures about it. "Some people feel like this whale. They feel that nobody understands them," says one artist. But maybe the whale is not sad at all. Maybe it just sings for {5}.

blanks.why: feel very lonely「覺得很孤單」，因為沒有其他鯨魚跟牠唱一樣的歌。modern（現代的）、national（國家的）、expensive（昂貴的）都不能形容心情。
The reason is simple「原因很簡單」，冒號後面說明原因。smoke、plant、grade 都不能這樣用。
probably cannot「大概無法」，probably 放在助動詞 cannot 前面。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。
a popular topic「熱門話題」，很多人為牠寫歌、畫畫。smoke、joy、middle 都不能用 popular … on the Internet 表示話題。
sing for joy「因為快樂而唱歌」。smoke、grade、topic 都不能和 sing for 搭配表示原因。

passages.zh: 從 1989 年開始，科學家就在太平洋聽到一種奇怪的鯨魚歌聲。大部分鯨魚唱歌的頻率大約是 15 到 25 赫茲，但這隻鯨魚唱的是 52 赫茲，沒有其他鯨魚像牠這樣唱。有些人認為牠一定覺得很孤單。原因很簡單：其他鯨魚大概聽不懂牠的歌。從來沒有人見過這隻鯨魚，但牠還是成了網路上的熱門話題，很多人為牠寫歌、畫圖。「有些人覺得自己就像這隻鯨魚，覺得沒有人懂他們。」一位藝術家說。但說不定這隻鯨魚一點都不難過，說不定牠只是因為快樂而唱歌。

passages.title: 廟裡的香
passages.text: Every New Year, my grandma takes me to the temple. As soon as we walk in, I can see {1} everywhere. It comes from the incense. People hold the incense and pray. Grandma told me the {2}: "The smoke carries our wishes up to the gods." In the {3} of the temple, there is a big metal pot for the incense. In recent years, some temples have asked people to use less incense. The {4} reason is that the smoke is bad for the air. Now many people just pray with their hands. Grandma said, "The gods will {5} understand. What's important is your heart."

blanks.why: see smoke everywhere「到處都看得到煙」，來自燒的香。joy（喜悅）、topic（主題）、grade（成績）都不能「看到」從香冒出來。
told me the reason「告訴我原因」，冒號後面就是原因。plant、grade、middle 都不是能「告訴」的理由。
in the middle of the temple「在廟的中間」，放著大香爐。topic、reason、joy 都不能表示位置。
the main reason「主要的原因」：煙對空氣不好。hungry、wet 不能形容原因；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
will probably understand「大概會理解」，probably 放在 will 和動詞中間。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。

passages.zh: 每年過年，阿嬤都會帶我去廟裡拜拜。我們一走進去，到處都看得到煙，那是從香冒出來的。大家拿著香祈禱。阿嬤告訴我原因：「煙會把我們的願望帶上去給神明。」廟的中間有一個大大的金屬香爐。這幾年，有些廟請大家少燒一點香，主要的原因是煙對空氣不好。現在很多人只用雙手合十拜拜。阿嬤說：「神明大概會理解的，最重要的是你的心。」

passages.title: 我演了主角
passages.text: This year, our class put on a play for the school's drama festival. To my surprise, I got the {1} role! I played a {2} old fisherman who lives on an island with no friends. I had to remember many words, and I practiced every night. On the day of the show, I was so nervous that my hands were shaking. But when I walked onto the stage, I forgot about my fear. In the {3} of the play, there is a sad scene. My character talks to the sea about his dead wife. When I finished, the hall was silent. Some students were even crying. In the end, our class won first place in the ninth {4}. My mom hugged me with tears of {5}.

blanks.why: the main role「主角」。hungry、wet 不能形容角色；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
a lonely old fisherman「孤單的老漁夫」，住在島上、沒有朋友。crowded（擁擠的）、national（國家的）、expensive（昂貴的）都不能形容人。
in the middle of the play「在戲演到一半的時候」。topic、reason、joy 都不能接 of the play 表示時間。
the ninth grade「九年級」，在九年級裡得到第一名。topic、reason、joy 都不能表示年級。
tears of joy「喜悅的眼淚」。smoke、topic、plant 都不能和 tears of 搭配。

passages.zh: 今年，我們班要在學校戲劇節演一齣戲。讓我意外的是，我竟然拿到了主角！我演一個住在島上、沒有朋友的孤單老漁夫。我要背很多台詞，每天晚上都在練習。演出當天，我緊張到手一直發抖，但一走上舞台，我就忘了害怕。戲演到一半有一幕很感人的場景：我的角色對著大海說起他過世的太太。我演完時，整個禮堂一片安靜，有些同學甚至哭了。最後，我們班拿下了九年級的第一名。媽媽流著喜悅的眼淚抱住了我。

passages.title: 小王子的玫瑰
passages.text: The Little Prince is a famous story from France. The {1} character is a little boy who lives on a very small planet. On his planet, there is a special {2}: a beautiful rose. He loves the rose and waters it every day. But the rose is proud and difficult, so one day he leaves. He travels to many planets and meets many strange adults. He feels {3} and misses his rose. On Earth, he meets a fox. The fox helps him see that time and care make someone special. Now the little prince understands the {4} his rose is so important to him. He decides to go home. Many readers say this book is {5} the most beautiful story they have ever read.

blanks.why: the main character「主角」。hungry、wet 不能形容角色；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
a special plant「一株特別的植物」，冒號後面說是一朵玫瑰。topic、grade、reason 都不能是玫瑰。
feels lonely「覺得孤單」，所以想念他的玫瑰。modern、national、expensive 都不能形容心情。
the reason his rose is so important「他的玫瑰這麼重要的原因」。smoke、joy、middle 都說不通。
is probably the most beautiful「大概是最美的」，probably 放在 be 動詞後面。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。

passages.zh: 《小王子》是一個來自法國的有名故事。主角是一個住在很小很小的星球上的小男孩。他的星球上有一株特別的植物：一朵美麗的玫瑰。他很愛那朵玫瑰，每天幫它澆水。可是玫瑰很驕傲、很難相處，所以有一天他離開了。他到了許多星球，遇到許多奇怪的大人。他覺得很孤單，很想念他的玫瑰。在地球上，他遇到一隻狐狸。狐狸讓他明白，是時間和用心讓一個人變得特別。這時小王子終於明白，他的玫瑰為什麼對他這麼重要。他決定回家。很多讀者說，這本書大概是他們讀過最美的故事。

passages.title: 爺爺的老盆栽
passages.text: My grandpa has a small tree in a pot. It's a bonsai, and it is over fifty years old! He got it from his father. Every morning, he waters it and cuts its leaves carefully. "Why do you spend so much time on one {1}?" I asked. "Because it teaches me to be patient," he said. Last winter, Grandpa was sick and stayed in the hospital for a month. The tree's leaves turned yellow. The {2} was simple: nobody watered it. When Grandpa came home, he looked at the tree in the {3} of the balcony. "It's {4} dying," he said. I felt terrible. But Grandpa didn't give up. He took care of it every day. In spring, new green leaves appeared. Grandpa's face was full of {5}. "See? It just needed someone to love it," he said.

blanks.why: one plant「一株植物」，指那棵盆栽。topic（主題）、grade（成績）、reason（原因）都不能澆水、剪葉子。
The reason was simple「原因很簡單」，冒號後面說明：沒人澆水。smoke、joy、middle 都不能這樣用。
in the middle of the balcony「在陽台中間」。topic、reason、joy 都不能表示位置。
It's probably dying.「它大概快死了」，probably 放在 be 動詞後面。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。
full of joy「充滿喜悅」，看到新葉子長出來。smoke、topic、grade 都不能形容臉上的表情。

passages.zh: 我爺爺有一棵種在花盆裡的小樹。它是一盆盆栽，已經超過五十歲了！是爺爺的爸爸留給他的。每天早上，他都會幫它澆水，小心地修剪葉子。「你為什麼要花這麼多時間在一棵植物上？」我問。「因為它教我要有耐心。」他說。去年冬天，爺爺生病住院一個月，那棵樹的葉子變黃了。原因很簡單：沒有人幫它澆水。爺爺回家後，看著陽台中間的那棵樹說：「它大概快死了。」我覺得很難過。但爺爺沒有放棄，每天照顧它。到了春天，新的綠葉長出來了，爺爺的臉上充滿了喜悅。「你看，它只是需要有人愛它。」他說。

passages.title: 一年級的第一天
passages.text: My little sister started first {1} this September. On her first day, she held Mom's hand tightly at the school gate. "I don't want to go," she cried. "I don't know anyone. I'll be so {2}." Mom hugged her. "You'll {3} make a new friend today," she said. "Just say hello." At four o'clock, we picked her up. She ran out of the classroom with a big smile and another little girl. "This is Ruby!" she shouted. "She sits next to me. We both love cats!" Then she told us everything about her day. Her favorite part was lunch, because she and Ruby sat in the {4} of the table and shared their snacks. Mom and I smiled at each other. Her {5} made our day, too.

blanks.why: first grade「一年級」。topic（主題）、reason（原因）、joy（喜悅）都不能表示年級。
I'll be so lonely「我會好孤單」，因為一個人都不認識。modern、national、expensive 都不能形容心情。
You'll probably make…「你大概會交到…」，probably 放在 will 和動詞中間。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。
in the middle of the table「坐在桌子中間」。topic、reason、joy 都不能表示位置。
Her joy made our day.「她的快樂也讓我們很開心」。smoke、topic、plant 都說不通。

passages.zh: 我妹妹今年九月上一年級了。第一天，她在校門口緊緊抓著媽媽的手。「我不要去，」她哭著說，「我一個人都不認識，我會好孤單。」媽媽抱住她：「你今天大概會交到一個新朋友。打聲招呼就好。」四點鐘我們去接她。她帶著大大的笑容，和另一個小女生一起跑出教室。「這是 Ruby！」她大喊，「她坐我旁邊，我們都喜歡貓！」接著她把一整天的事都告訴我們。她最喜歡的是午餐時間，因為她和 Ruby 坐在桌子中間，一起分享零食。我和媽媽相視而笑。她的快樂也讓我們一整天都很開心。

passages.title: 馬路中間的烏龜
passages.text: One Saturday morning, my dad and I were driving to the market. Suddenly, Dad stopped the car. There was a turtle in the {1} of the road! It was walking very slowly, and cars were coming from the other side. "If we don't help it, it will {2} get hit," Dad said. He turned on the warning lights and got out. He picked up the turtle carefully and carried it to the side of the road, next to a small river. Some drivers honked at us, but one woman gave us a thumbs-up. Later, I looked up turtles on the Internet. I found out the {3} reason turtles cross roads: they are looking for a place to lay eggs. That day, we were late for the market, but we had a good {4}. Helping the turtle gave me a lot of {5}.

blanks.why: in the middle of the road「在馬路中間」。topic、reason、joy 都不能表示位置。
will probably get hit「大概會被撞」，probably 放在 will 和動詞中間。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。
the main reason「主要的原因」：烏龜要找地方下蛋。hungry、wet 不能形容原因；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
had a good reason「有很好的理由」遲到。smoke、plant、grade 都說不通。
gave me a lot of joy「帶給我很多快樂」。smoke、topic、grade 都不是幫助烏龜後的感受。

passages.zh: 一個星期六早上，我和爸爸開車去市場。突然，爸爸把車停了下來：馬路中間有一隻烏龜！牠走得非常慢，對面還有車子開過來。「如果我們不幫牠，牠大概會被撞到。」爸爸說。他打開警示燈下了車，小心地把烏龜拿起來，帶到路邊一條小河旁。有些駕駛對我們按喇叭，但有一位女士對我們豎起大拇指。後來，我上網查了烏龜的資料，發現烏龜過馬路主要的原因是要找地方下蛋。那天我們去市場遲到了，但我們有很好的理由。幫助那隻烏龜讓我非常快樂。

passages.title: 植物喜歡聽音樂嗎？
passages.text: For the science fair, my partner and I chose an interesting {1}: "Do plants like music?" We bought six small bean {2} and put them in two groups. For three weeks, the first group listened to soft piano music every day. The second group had no music. We gave all of them the same water and sunlight. At the end, the plants with music were a little taller. "Maybe it's because of the music," my partner said. "Or maybe it's just luck," I said. "We {3} need more plants to be sure." Our teacher liked our honest answer. "The {4} thing in science is to ask good questions," she said. We didn't win a prize, but we got a good {5}.

blanks.why: an interesting topic「有趣的題目」，冒號後面就是題目。smoke、joy、middle 都不能當科展題目。
bean plants「豆子的植株」，分成兩組實驗。topics、grades、reasons 都不能「買」來聽音樂。
probably need「大概需要」，probably 放在一般動詞前面。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。
the main thing「最重要的事」。hungry、wet 放在這裡不通；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
got a good grade「得到好成績」。smoke（煙）、middle（中間）、joy（喜悅）都不能用 got a good … 表示成績。

passages.zh: 為了科展，我和夥伴選了一個有趣的題目：「植物喜歡音樂嗎？」我們買了六株小小的豆苗，分成兩組。三個星期裡，第一組每天聽輕柔的鋼琴音樂，第二組沒有音樂。我們給它們一樣多的水和陽光。最後，有聽音樂的那組長得稍微高一點。「也許是因為音樂。」我的夥伴說。「也可能只是運氣，」我說，「我們大概需要更多植物才能確定。」老師很欣賞我們誠實的答案。「科學最重要的，就是問出好問題。」她說。我們沒有得獎，但拿到了不錯的成績。

passages.title: 半夜響起的警報器
passages.text: At three in the morning, a loud beeping sound woke our whole family up. It was the smoke alarm! Dad jumped out of bed. "Is there a fire?" he shouted. We ran into the living room, but there was no {1} anywhere. We checked the kitchen too. Everything was fine. "The battery is {2} low," Mom said. She was right. When a smoke alarm's battery is low, it beeps to tell you. Dad changed the battery, and the noise stopped. My little brother was standing in the {3} of the room in his pajamas. "Can we go back to sleep now?" he asked. Everybody laughed. The next morning, Dad said, "That wasn't fun, but the alarm did its {4} job: it woke us up. That's a good {5} to check our alarms every year."

blanks.why: no smoke anywhere「到處都沒有煙」，所以沒有失火。joy、topic、grade 都不是失火時會看到的東西。
is probably low「大概沒電了」，probably 放在 be 動詞後面。ago、abroad、ahead 都不能放在這裡。
in the middle of the room「在客廳中間」。topic、reason、joy 都不能表示位置。
its main job「它主要的工作」：把人叫醒。hungry、wet 不能形容工作；afraid 不能放在名詞前面。
a good reason to…「做…的好理由」。smoke、plant、grade 都不能接 to check 表示理由。

passages.zh: 凌晨三點，一陣很大的嗶嗶聲把全家人都吵醒了，是煙霧警報器！爸爸從床上跳起來大喊：「失火了嗎？」我們跑到客廳，到處都沒有煙，又檢查了廚房，一切都沒事。「大概是電池沒電了。」媽媽說。她說對了：煙霧警報器的電池快沒電時，就會嗶嗶叫來提醒你。爸爸換了電池，聲音就停了。弟弟穿著睡衣站在客廳中間問：「我們現在可以回去睡覺了嗎？」大家都笑了。隔天早上，爸爸說：「昨晚一點都不好玩，但警報器做到了它主要的工作：把我們叫醒。這是我們每年都要檢查警報器的好理由。」
